title: Evaluating AI capabilities in detecting conspiracy theories on YouTube

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing precision and recall metrics, alongside Normalized Expected Cost (NEC) under varying cost matrices, to identify the models' tendency to disproportionately flag content as conspiracy-related (high recall, low precision) due to training biases.

Conducting qualitative error analysis on misclassified instances (false positives and false negatives) to observe subjective challenges in distinguishing doctrinal religious claims from deceptive conspiracy narratives.

Measuring inter-rater reliability (Cohen's kappa) and qualitatively reviewing human-labeled ground truth instances to identify subjectivity, contextual dependence, and dataset-specific nuances in defining conspiracy content.
